physics-killer-01.topic: Usaha lan owah-owahan timbal balik energi mekanik
physics-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-01.material: Ing rel roller coaster tanpa gesekan, benda miwiti saka kahanan meneng ing titik A kanthi dhuwur $50\,\mathrm{m}$. Dhuwur telung titik ing rel kaya ing tabel: titik B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, titik C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, titik D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Yen hambatan hawa diabaikan lan $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake pirang kali (kacepetan ing C) saka (kacepetan ing B), lan kacepetan ing D?
physics-killer-01.thinking.0: Usaha lan owah-owahan timbal balik energi mekanik
physics-killer-01.s.s1.prompt: Ing rel roller coaster tanpa gesekan, benda miwiti saka kahanan meneng ing titik A kanthi dhuwur $50\,\mathrm{m}$. Dhuwur telung titik ing rel kaya ing tabel: titik B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, titik C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, titik D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Yen hambatan hawa diabaikan lan $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake pirang kali (kacepetan ing C) saka (kacepetan ing B), lan kacepetan ing D?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: Amarga meneng ing A, saka $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ dadi $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Mula $v_C/v_B=2$ kali, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kacepetan ora sebanding karo dhuwur sing diudhunake nanging sebanding karo $\sqrt{\Delta h}$ (jawaban salah ①), yen dhuwur D $5\,\mathrm{m}$ dikira dhuwur sing diudhunake dadi $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (jawaban salah ③), lan yen $\frac12$ ketinggalan dadi $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (jawaban salah ④).

physics-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

Mula $v_C/v_B=2$ kali, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kacepetan ora sebanding karo dhuwur sing diudhunake nanging sebanding karo $\sqrt{\Delta h}$ (jawaban salah ①), yen dhuwur D $5\,\mathrm{m}$ dikira dhuwur sing diudhunake dadi $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (jawaban salah ③), lan yen $\frac12$ ketinggalan dadi $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (jawaban salah ④).
